name: azure-scientific-podcast-studio
description: Azure Scientific Podcast Studio — a self-service research-to-podcast factory for scientific and healthcare users.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @studio/domain && npm run build --workspace @studio/ssml && npm run build --workspace @studio/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b tsconfig.build.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.node.json && npm run typecheck --workspace @studio/api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @studio/domain && npm run test --workspace @studio/ssml && npm run test --workspace @studio/api
